scope: Mapped surviving levelled fourth-bailey earthwork at Chihaya Castle: complete retained20-corner lower precinct ground surface and edge slopes, shaped by original numerical elevation values. No surviving keep is claimed. Upper enclosures, ridge ditch, modern shrine/teahouse, signs, steles, trees, whole natural hill and approach staircase are outside this constituent; whole Chihaya Castle remains unfinished.

Official village2018newsletter identifies the flat area reached by the long steps as the artificially levelled fourth bailey. Numerical site boundary is contextual mapped extent, not an archaeological survey or certified medieval bank line. Actual source terrain sampled without levelling, invented ramparts, source shifting or host fitting.
